reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 for Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the Pemberline Dock subscription at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also mentioned that Amendment No. 3 was signed on 2026-09-22 and raises the count to 230 seats. It doesn't take effect until 2027-01-01, so 185 is still the count today.

Dana is on the North team, which handles Quarrendon, and seat counts aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed. I only gave her seat counts and dates, no money terms.
